== Biography ==
Mary was born in 1732. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1226|Thomas Glasgow]] and [[Clarkson-2169|Catherine Clarkson]]. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1226]] is assessed at 98% (proved). Mary’s 1732 Livingston transcript names Tho and Cathrin, with maternal surname absent. Same parish and close sequence after Andrew support the existing Thomas account without filling that missing surname.

Existing child-to-father link assessed from held public evidence; Thomas is defined by the Clarkson/Classon household; proposed 1675 childhood and upstream parents remain uncertain.

Next useful test: Inspect original for omitted maternal surname and residence.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4151277&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929: Mary Glasgow, 23 Jan 1732, record SCOT/OPR/BAP/4151277].
